'''''Blood Freeze''''' was a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] owned and operated by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vimdin]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Vimdin docked the ''Blood Freeze'' in [[Docking Bay 65]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Betwixt" />
